scope: All 31 remaining whole-token sušstv- existence forms in the live v019 Latin corpus: 25 inflected existence nouns and six finite or infinitive existence verbs.
choice: Extend the official type-1 obstajati/obstajanje paradigm already adopted in EDIT-0025 to the missed sušstv- spelling variant, preserving noun case and verb person or infinitive morphology.
motivation: Every site denotes literal mathematical existence: existence theorems and proofs, existence of functions, constants, ideals, value systems, or fields. None denotes essence, essentiality, presence/currentness, or an entity. The variant escaped EDIT-0025's source inventory and otherwise leaves a malformed Russian/Bulgarian-shaped doublet inside an already-normalized semantic family.
alternatives_rejected: Regularize sušstv- to sųtstvovati/sųtstvo: EDIT-0025 rejected that official type-3 RU/BG-derived family in favor of type-1 obstajati.
Use sučnost or sučstven-: those denote essence or essentiality and would change the meaning of all 31 existence contexts.
Treat the missed spelling as harmless: it fragments a central mathematical term and contradicts the accepted zero-old-family policy of EDIT-0025.
Apply a substring replacement: exact whole-token inflection mapping is required to preserve genitive, dative/locative, infinitive, singular-present, and plural-present morphology.

prior_existence_decision.binding: official obstajati paradigm and explicit rejection of type-3 sųtstvovati/sųtstvo
